message.content: In the discussions surrounding the community garden renovation, Li Hua offers several thoughtful suggestions to Adam Smith. Initially, she proposes adding more seating areas for people to relax and enjoy the space. Additionally, Li Hua suggests incorporating flower beds with native plants, which she believes would be beneficial for attracting more butterflies and bees. Furthermore, she recommends including a small herb section, noting that this would make the garden more useful and enjoyable for visitors. These suggestions demonstrate Li Hua's commitment to enhancing the functionality and aesthetic appeal of the garden.
